articles.en: Can apps teach you a language?
articles.zh: 手机App能教会你一门外语吗？
body: Millions of people try to learn a new language with a phone app, studying on the bus or for a few minutes before bed.
数百万人在公交车上或睡前几分钟，用手机App学一门新语言。
Apps are cheap, fun and always available, but research suggests they work best as a helper, not as a full replacement for a teacher.
App便宜、有趣、随时能用，但研究表明它们最适合当帮手，而不是完全替代老师。
Speaking with real people still builds fluency faster, so the best plan is to combine an app with real conversation practice.
和真人对话仍然能更快练出流利度，所以最好的方案是App加真实对话练习两条腿走路。
tips: 改变局面的事物／大有帮助

articles.en: Why does heartbreak hurt so much?
body: When a relationship ends, many people feel real pain in their body, not just sadness in their mind.
当一段感情结束时，很多人感受到的是身体上真实的疼，而不只是心里的难过。
Scientists say heartbreak activates the same brain areas as physical pain, which is why breakups and loss hurt so much.
科学家说，心碎会激活和身体疼痛相同的脑区，这就是分手和失去那么痛的原因。
Time, support from friends and building new routines can help the brain slowly recover from a broken heart.
时间、朋友的支持和建立新的生活习惯，能帮助大脑慢慢从心碎中恢复过来。

articles.zh: 被拒绝，其实对我们有好处？
body: Asking a stranger for a small favour feels scary, but researchers found that rejection hurts far less than we expect.
向陌生人寻求小帮助听起来很可怕，但研究者发现，被拒绝带来的痛远比我们想象的轻。
In one experiment, people asked strangers for favours all day, and most of the requests were accepted, not refused.
在一个实验里，参与者整天向陌生人求助，结果大多数请求都被答应了，而不是被拒绝。
The lesson for work and life is clear: fear of rejection stops us more often than rejection itself, so it is worth asking.
对工作和生活的启发很明确：对被拒绝的恐惧，比拒绝本身更常拦住我们，所以开口值得一试。
tips: 大胆去尝试／把自己推向机会

articles.en: Is aircon the answer to a heating world?
articles.zh: 空调是变热世界的答案吗？
body: As the world gets hotter, more and more people are installing air conditioning in their homes.
随着世界越来越热，越来越多人在家里安装空调。
Aircon keeps rooms cool, but it uses a lot of electricity and can make climate change worse in the long run.
空调能让房间凉快，但它耗电量大，长远来看还会加剧气候变化。
Some cities are trying greener answers, such as planting more trees, cool roofs and smarter building design.
一些城市正在尝试更环保的办法，比如多种树、屋顶降温材料以及更聪明的建筑设计。
Young people in many countries are drinking less alcohol than their parents did at the same age.
很多国家的年轻人，喝酒比他们父母在同一年龄段时喝得少。
Health campaigns, higher prices and the rise of alcohol-free drinks are quietly changing drinking habits.
健康宣传、更高的价格，以及无酒精饮料的兴起，正在悄悄改变人们的饮酒习惯。
Bars and supermarkets now sell more non-alcoholic beer and mocktails than ever before.
酒吧和超市现在卖出的无酒精啤酒和无酒精鸡尾酒，比以往任何时候都多。
tips: 对少酒／戒酒生活方式感兴趣
